mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname, u.email, o.plan_key, o.cycle, o.amount, o.status, o.payment_method, o.third_party_trade_id, o.paid_at, o.refunded_at, o.refund_reason, o.refund_amount, o.third_party_refund_id, o.admin_remark, o.operator_id, o.created_at FROM u_order o LEFT JOIN u_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE u_order SET status = 1, paid_at = #{now}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

UPDATE u_order SET status = 2, refunded_at = #{now}, refund_reason = #{reason}, third_party_refund_id = #{thirdPartyRefundId}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE u_order SET status = 3, operator_id = #{operatorId}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO u_order (order_no, user_id, plan_key, cycle, started_at, expires_at, amount, status, paid_at, admin_remark, operator_id, tenant_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{planKey}, 'custom', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 0, 1, #{now}, #{adminRemark}, #{operatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 AND DATE(paid_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrderCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 AND DATE(paid_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayRevenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')) AS monthOrderCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')) AS monthRevenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u_order WHERE status = 1) AS totalOrderCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM u_order WHERE status = 1) AS totalRevenue

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%m-%d') AS dateLabel, COALESCE(stats.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(stats.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS dt FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) nums WHERE n < #{days} ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(paid_at) AS payDate, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 AND paid_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(paid_at) ) stats ON stats.payDate = d.dt ORDER BY d.dt ASC
SELECT plan_key AS planKey, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY plan_key ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT cycle, COUNT(*) AS count FROM u_order WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY cycle ORDER BY count DESC

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS totalPaidUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN user_id END) AS renewalUsers, COUNT(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN 1 END) AS renewalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS renewalRevenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 END) AS firstOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS firstRevenue FROM paid_orders

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ), renewal_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(o.paid_at) AS payDate, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS userCount FROM paid_orders o WHERE o.rn > 1 AND o.paid_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(o.paid_at) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%m-%d') AS dateLabel, COALESCE(rd.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(rd.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(rd.userCount, 0) AS userCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS dt FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) nums WHERE n < #{days} ) d LEFT JOIN renewal_daily rd ON rd.payDate = d.dt ORDER BY d.dt ASC

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ) SELECT plan_key AS planKey, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue FROM paid_orders WHERE rn > 1 GROUP BY plan_key ORDER BY count DESC

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ) SELECT cycle, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue FROM paid_orders WHERE rn > 1 GROUP BY cycle ORDER BY count DESC

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ), user_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, MIN(paid_at) AS firstPaidAt, MAX(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN paid_at END) AS lastRenewalAt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS renewalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS renewalAmount FROM paid_orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING renewalCount > 0 ) SELECT us.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.email AS email, us.firstPaidAt AS firstPaidAt, us.lastRenewalAt AS lastRenewalAt, us.renewalCount AS renewalCount, us.renewalAmount AS renewalAmount, m.level AS currentLevel, m.expires_at AS expiresAt FROM user_stats us JOIN u_user u ON u.id = us.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN u_user_membership m ON m.user_id = us.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND us.lastRenewalAt >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND us.firstPaidAt >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND us.lastRenewalAt <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND us.firstPaidAt <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM paid_orders po WHERE po.user_id = us.user_id AND po.rn > 1 AND po.plan_key = #{planKey} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM paid_orders po WHERE po.user_id = us.user_id AND po.rn > 1 AND po.cycle = #{cycle} )
ORDER BY us.lastRenewalAt DESC ORDER BY us.firstPaidAt DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ), user_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, MIN(paid_at) AS firstPaidAt, MAX(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN paid_at END) AS lastRenewalAt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS renewalCount FROM paid_orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING renewalCount > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_stats us JOIN u_user u ON u.id = us.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND us.lastRenewalAt >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND us.firstPaidAt >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND us.lastRenewalAt <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND us.firstPaidAt <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM paid_orders po WHERE po.user_id = us.user_id AND po.rn > 1 AND po.plan_key = #{planKey} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM paid_orders po WHERE po.user_id = us.user_id AND po.rn > 1 AND po.cycle = #{cycle} )

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid_orders o LEFT JOIN u_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND o.rn = 1 AND o.rn > 1
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.plan_key = #{planKey}
AND o.cycle = #{cycle}
AND o.paid_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.paid_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')

WITH paid_orders AS ( SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC) AS rn FROM u_order o WHERE o.status = 1 ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM paid_orders o LEFT JOIN u_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND o.rn = 1 AND o.rn > 1
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.plan_key = #{planKey}
AND o.cycle = #{cycle}
AND o.paid_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.paid_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
